# Brij Bhoomi Foundation - AI Crawl Information
# https://www.brijbhoomifoundation.org/

## About
Brij Bhoomi Foundation is a registered non-profit NGO based in Vrindavan, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India.
We create sustainable social impact through education, healthcare, women empowerment, environmental conservation, rural development, youth development, and humanitarian support.

## Mission
To create sustainable social impact through community-driven development programs across India.

## Vision
To build an inclusive, empowered, and sustainable society where every individual has access to education, healthcare, and equal opportunities.

## Programs
- Education for Every Child: Scholarships, digital learning, school infrastructure
- Healthcare & Medical Assistance: Free camps, blood donation, preventive health
- Women Empowerment: Skill development, entrepreneurship, financial literacy
- Environmental Conservation: Tree plantation, water conservation, biodiversity
- Rural Development: Clean water, sanitation, infrastructure, livelihood
- Youth Development: Career guidance, leadership, entrepreneurship
- Disaster Relief: Emergency food, shelter, medical, rehabilitation
- Community Development: Awareness campaigns, civic engagement

## Contact
Address: Near Raman Reti, Vrindavan, Mathura District, UP 281121, India
Phone: +91 565 244 1088
Email: info@brijbhoomifoundation.org

## Registrations
- Registered NGO under Section 8, Companies Act
- 80G Tax Exemption Certificate
- 12A Registration (Income Tax)
- CSR Registration (MCA Form CSR-1)
- NGO DARPAN ID (NITI Aayog)
